d: The Technical Instructor/Assessor is responsible for delivery of Technical Training to students within the BAE Systems Technical Institute in Doha, Qatar.

The Technical Instructor/Assessor will deliver a range of training modules, across the General Engineering Aerospace Mechanical programme. The successful delivery of the modules will contribute toward the learner’s attainment of externally accredited qualifications.

The Technical Instructor/Assessor will assess learner performance, in accordance with the assessment strategy in force for the modules. Assessment of learners may take place from within or outside of their trade boundary, to allow for independence.
The Technical Instructor/Assessor will actively contribute to the continuing improvement of the QTI, through identification of ideas and embracing the suggestions of others.
The roles will deliver Aerospace Mechanical General Engineering to QAF students within the TI, both in the classroom and the workshops.
The roles will utilize both presentation media and training devices and assets to deliver training and the instructor must be proficient in all methods.
The roles will conduct assessment of the learners, either through practical or knowledge- based testing, in accordance with the assessment strategy in place.
q: Level 4 Qualification in Teaching & learning (including 90 hrs teaching practice)
5yrs training delivery experience gained outside of the TI (or 2yrs within) delivering:
2years experience in training design following BSAT/DSAT model
r: Responsible for the delivery of the basic and specialty engineering programmes within the TI ensuring training is delivered to plan and quality.
Establish and maintain effective links with local QEAF Cadet Welfare teams to ensure their support is forthcoming to cadet welfare and discipline issues.
Maintain and develop a customer focused approach that delivers customer satisfaction.
Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory and corporate requirements.
Ensure all SHE requirements are met in the training environment. Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory and corporate requirements.

d: At Aleph , we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
ChatGPT Ads by Aleph. Now local. And this is your chance to be part of it.

OpenAI has named Aleph its exclusive reseller of ChatGPT Ads in 44 countries, so brands and agencies can contract, pay and get support locally. People come to ChatGPT to learn, explore and make decisions, and ChatGPT Ads gives brands a new way to be part of those moments. At Aleph, you will help make that happen.

As a Senior Client Partner for ChatGPT Ads by Aleph in Qatar, you will advise key advertisers and media agencies in your market on how to achieve their marketing objectives through our partner’s digital advertising platform. You will own the outbound sales cycle for advertising revenue: sourcing and closing new advertiser relationships, then setting them up to grow.
You will build a pipeline from scratch, run a disciplined sales process, and close commercial deals that turn prospects into long-term partners.
q: 4–6 years of experience in advertising sales, digital media sales, media sales or a closely related field, with a track record of winning new business.
Consultative thinking, ideally with exposure to a consulting environment, and the ability to understand client goals and shape proposals that meet their needs.
Strategic thinking, with the ability to discuss strategic direction and align deal structure to clients’ business goals.
A strong new-business drive: a genuine motivation to originate and close new business, energized by competitive wins and new-client acquisition rather than only growing an existing book.
Strong commercial and negotiation skills, with comfort owning direct revenue responsibility and negotiating high-value agreements.
Proven ability to create, maintain and grow customer relationships, including with senior stakeholders.
Analytical skills: comfort with analytics tools and the ability to turn data into insight, and insight into a compelling commercial narrative.
Good understanding of the ad-tech landscape, its underlying technology and the major players in it.
Project management skills to prioritize and manage multiple sales opportunities at once without losing pipeline discipline.
Presentation skills: the ability to pitch ideas and proposals in a concise, innovative way.
Operational discipline, with consistent CRM and pipeline updates and a firm grasp of your numbers.
Local market knowledge of Qatar and a network that gives you the credibility to open conversations with advertisers and agencies quickly.
Comfort with ambiguity: you work well in fast-changing environments where the playbook is still being written.
r: Prospect, qualify, source and close new advertising opportunities with brand advertisers and media agencies, leading the sales cycle from first engagement through contract execution.
Sell across a full portfolio of digital advertising solutions, matching products to each prospect’s campaign objectives and KPI benchmarks.
Own and consistently deliver a defined new-business revenue target within an assigned territory or vertical.

Structure and negotiate commercial agreements, applying solid knowledge of media agency dynamics, campaign buying, digital media planning and pricing models, with support from senior colleagues on the most complex deals.
Quantify opportunities through clear, data-driven business cases aligned to each advertiser’s objectives.
Develop and execute structured account and territory plans that drive advertiser ROI and long-term revenue growth.
Stay current on market and competitor movements, new product launches and industry events, and use that intelligence to generate new business leads.
Build and maintain relationships with advertising decision-makers, offering strategic guidance and gathering their feedback.
Deliver an excellent sales experience throughout the cycle, resolve client issues efficiently and tactfully, and feed lessons learned back into how future issues are prevented.
Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to ensure smooth post-sale transitions, campaign launches and coordinated expansion strategies.
Maintain rigorous pipeline management and CRM hygiene, with accurate weekly, monthly and annual forecasting of new business revenue.
x: Impact: Own new-business revenue in Qatar and bring new advertisers onto ChatGPT Ads, one of the defining platforms of the AI era.
Growth: Build your own pipeline and territory, and develop your senior-level network and consultative selling skills.
Team culture: Work with CSM and cross-functional teams who collaborate openly to turn new clients into long-term partners, in an inclusive environment where every voice is heard.
Industry context: Help advertisers in Doha and across Qatar get more from a fast-moving digital advertising landscape, with new products and formats arriving regularly.
Ownership: Shape your own approach, with the autonomy to define how you win in your territory or vertical.
